verdict.rationale: Mercury is a business banking platform, not an AI agent or assistant host, so acting as an MCP client that consumes other servers' tools does not fit its product category. The evidence shows Mercury only in the opposite role: it publishes its own MCP server at mcp.mercury.com for external AI tools to connect to. That server-side capability belongs to a different story and is not credited here. Nothing in the pack shows Mercury connecting to or using third-party MCP servers.
